question:
Please list the Italian names of the cards in the set Coldsnap with the highest converted mana cost.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: card set Coldsnap refers to name = 'Coldsnap'; Italian refers to language = 'Italian'; highest converted mana cost refers to MAX(convertedManaCost)

prediction.sql:
SELECT fd.XCL_079
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.XCL_063 = s.XCL_099
JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.XCL_072 = fd.XCL_082
WHERE s.XCL_110 = 'Coldsnap'
  AND fd.XCL_077 = 'Italian'
  AND c.XCL_011 = (
    SELECT MAX(c2.XCL_011)
    FROM cards c2
    JOIN sets s2 ON c2.XCL_063 = s2.XCL_099
    WHERE s2.XCL_110 = 'Coldsnap'
  )
